title: Qiaoyi and GEKA showcase complementary beauty solutions at Cosmoprof Asia Hong Kong 2026
summary: Qiaoyi, a part of medmix beauty will exhibit at Cosmoprof Asia Hong Kong 2026 joined by colleagues from GEKA’s sales and innovation team. Visitors can meet the teams at Booth 6- F11, AWE Hall 6 and discover their complementary beauty packaging and application solutions

extraction.key_fact: Qiaoyi와 GEKA가 코스모프로프 아시아 홍콩 2026에서 포장과 도포 솔루션을 선보인다
